create_resource_monitoring_thread: create a ResourceMonitoringThread to periodically sample CPU, I/O, and thread stats for a given PID
run_resource_monitoring_thread: run a ResourceMonitoringThread that collects system resource stats and passes samples to a callback function
stop_resource_monitoring_thread: stop a running ResourceMonitoringThread by setting its internal event to terminate the sampling loop
build_resource_stats_sample: build a ResourceStatsSample dataclass instance containing timestamped CPU, I/O, and thread metrics
summarize_resource_stats_sample: summarize a ResourceStatsSample by converting it to a tuple or listing its dataclass fields
